end.parentNote: Ishita practised using dot pictures to show square and triangular number sequences. They clearly described how a new row or column makes the next term and later explained that a shared corner must not be counted twice. There was an initial mix-up about whether to add or subtract the shared corner, which was clarified later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw the first four square and triangular pictures and label the dots added each time.
